note: Discharge Process Processes is drawn by a copy of the latest Solutions generator (Bed Management/solutions-html-generator/bm_solutions_html.py) pointed at Processes, with the Processes motifs of the library (the ward board, magnets, name badges, chairs, instrument windows, the trial strip, the loop) layered in dp_pr_blocks.py, and the layered Solutions drawings that fit process work (people, sizing, gauges, owners, findings, circuit), all in the Discharge Processes look: the ward board (heather, aubergine, plum).

theme.name: Discharge Process · Processes: the ward board

tones.rule: The background changes every four turns: turns 1–4 the ward board (ruled), 5–8 the night board (dots), 9–12 the ward board, 13–14 the night board. Specs store no colour.

variety.rule: Every turn looks different (rules/08 §2). The main block is used by one turn only in Solutions; no block but heading and effect in two turns in a row.

actions.rule: rules/08 §8: the three buttons on every turn. Processes jumps back to Diagnosis.

blocks.from: library heading (Processes), with the ward board from the Processes landing page
blocks.purpose: Eyebrow, title and deck, with a small ward board: which column of the board this turn is about.
use_when: every turn

blocks.purpose: Each step of the day, its magnet moved from today to with the changes.
use_when: what changes on the ward, step by step
blocks.interaction: Pick a step to open it. Move one magnet, or all of them with the switch.

blocks.purpose: The two weeks on one ward: the day strip you can play, the phases as pickable bands, the ward still to choose.
use_when: scoping a short trial
blocks.interaction: Pick a phase, or play the two weeks. Type the ward you choose.

blocks.purpose: Name badges on the board, grouped by what each person does: who agrees, who is still to ask, who has a worry.
use_when: who has to agree, team by team
blocks.interaction: Pick a badge to open it. Filter by the trial or still to ask.

blocks.purpose: The roles as chairs, their triggers as lamps, the busy-hours check as a day strip with a slider.
use_when: whether to hire, and how many
blocks.interaction: Pick a role to open it. Move the slider and switch the sizing rule.

blocks.purpose: The measures as instrument windows: the starting number where there is one, dashed where nobody has one yet.
use_when: the measures to watch
blocks.interaction: Pick a window to open it. Filter by when it is read; flip to after the trial.

blocks.purpose: Plan, try, measure, adjust, spread: a wheel with a yes-or-no check that sends you on or back.
use_when: what happens after a trial
blocks.interaction: Step round, or pick a step. At the check, answer yes or not yet.

blocks.purpose: One normal day’s times on one line. Blank: the times are typed straight into the drawing. Filled: the times and the gaps between them.
use_when: asking for real times
showing them back
blocks.interaction: Type a time on each step (blank), or pick a step to open it (filled).

blocks.purpose: Each job on one clock from the evening round to the next afternoon: when it happens today, and with the changes.
use_when: the same work started the night before
blocks.interaction: Pick a job to open it. Switch between today and with the changes.

blocks.from: library motif: the lightbulb; the chain wrapped three and three with an elbow
blocks.purpose: The steps of one part as switches on one wire, from where the data starts to a bulb that lights only when every switch is on.
use_when: a part that is a sequence of steps, each needing the one before
showing that the outcome only arrives at the end of the chain
avoid_when: parts that do not depend on each other
blocks.interaction: Pick a switch: it is raised and its sheet opens, the current runs from the plug to it, and the bulb lights at the last switch.

blocks.purpose: The quantity the part is aimed at, named once. Its look changes from turn to turn: door plate, stamp, ticket, banner, meter.
use_when: the part has one number it moves
avoid_when: more than two in a turn

blocks.from: library motif: the lightbulb; the converge pattern with a rail
blocks.purpose: What the hospital provides, wired into one engine, and what comes out of it.
use_when: how a part is achieved
showing that many steps are one build
blocks.interaction: Pick an input: its wire lights and the outputs it feeds light up. Its sheet opens.

blocks.from: library motif: the drafting sheet; a building section
blocks.purpose: What Tojo brings above the ground line, what must already be there below it, and a switch for a hospital still on paper.
use_when: what we supply against what must exist
blocks.interaction: Pick a box to open it. The switch redraws the building for a hospital that is mostly on paper.

blocks.purpose: A few pinned drafting cards, each opening its sheet.
use_when: a handful of smaller items beside a main drawing
avoid_when: the main drawing of a turn
blocks.interaction: Pick a card to raise it and open its sheet.

blocks.from: 07 visual grammar: amber for new roles, a two-way arrow for peers
blocks.purpose: Two owners as peers, joined by a two-way arrow, with the one line that explains why both are needed.
use_when: two roles that only work together
blocks.interaction: Pick an owner to open what the job is.

blocks.from: library route, drawn as a loop
blocks.purpose: Try a change: the plan re-runs, new call-in times go out, and the change is recorded.
use_when: showing that a change is handled, not a rule broken
blocks.interaction: Pick a change. The loop runs again, box by box, and its sheet says what moved.

blocks.from: the Bed Management home page: rooms on a ward plan; 07 sign-off tag
blocks.purpose: Six teams as rooms on one plan, each with what it receives, then who signs it off and the two managers under them.
use_when: key people and buy-in
blocks.interaction: Pick a room to see what changes for that team.

blocks.from: library chain pattern, with a live slider
blocks.purpose: The roles, then the two sizing chains: one settled, one waiting on the hospital’s figures.
use_when: teams and numbers
blocks.interaction: Pick a role to open it. Move the slider and the headcount changes. Type a figure into the chain that waits for it.

blocks.purpose: What can be costed now, and the numbers still needed, typed in place.
use_when: a cost with gaps
blocks.interaction: Type each missing number in place. Every entry goes into the message.

blocks.from: library motif: the drafting instrument; the landing page stops
blocks.purpose: The measures as dials. New ones are dashed with no needle, because nobody reads them today.
use_when: what to measure
blocks.interaction: Pick a dial to open it. Filter to the early warnings or the results.

blocks.from: 07: muted fill for the hospital’s own facts
blocks.purpose: The hospital’s own findings, muted, because they are its facts and not our proposals.
use_when: a summary
blocks.interaction: Pick a finding to open where it came from.
